# Missing prebuilt bytes fail before ssh -G, signer or a source build.
! skygo-ssh --host dgx --known-hosts kh --agent-binary $WORK/missing --agent-commit $COMMIT --agent-digest $DIGEST jobs list
stderr 'agentbinary:'
! stderr 'MODELED'
# Configuration shape is checked even for commands that need no agent.
! skygo-ssh --host dgx --known-hosts kh --agent-binary $WORK/missing --agent-commit HEAD --agent-digest $DIGEST help
stderr commit
! stderr 'MODELED'
